data.title: Sta. Cruz Day Care Overhaul Marks New Milestone for CSTEP Initiative
data.desc:
The Day Care Center in Barangay Sta. Cruz has recently undergone major improvements through the Community Skills Training and Livelihood Entrepreneurship Program (CSTEP), bringing better facilities for children and teachers in the community.

City Councilor Josie Mary “Boss JM” Relampagos personally inspected the newly completed construction and renovation on January 26, 2026. The project addressed the barangay’s long-standing need for tiled flooring and a more presentable, clean, and functional kitchen suitable for daily use.

As Chairperson of the Committee on Education and the Committee on Social Services, Councilor Relampagos actively coordinated with various government agencies to ensure the immediate response to the needs of the barangay. The project was made possible through the joint efforts of the City Mayor’s Office under the leadership of Mayor Jose E. Relampagos, the City Public Employment Service Office (CPESO) led by PESO Manager/CTEC Cherelle B. Espinosa, and the Barangay Sta. Cruz local government headed by Barangay Captain Alger Taran.

The renovation was implemented through the CSTEP program, which is part of the city’s Skills Training Ordinance. The program provides free skills training and livelihood opportunities for Panabo residents, particularly the youth and the unemployed.

In Barangay Sta. Cruz, the Day Care Center served as a hands-on training site where trainees applied their construction skills as part of their on-the-job training. Through their efforts, the facility now features newly tiled floors and a renovated kitchen that was previously unsuitable for use. The improvements have resulted in a cleaner, safer, and more child-friendly environment.

The project highlights how the CSTEP program not only equips participants with practical skills but also delivers tangible and meaningful benefits to local communities through visible and usable outputs. Following Barangay Buenavista and Barangay Sta. Cruz, Barangay Mabunao is next in line to benefit from the program.

The local government of Panabo reaffirmed its commitment to continuing programs and services that promote community development and improve public facilities for the welfare of its constituents.

data.title: PANABO CITY SPORTS FESTIVAL 2025 WRAPS UP WITH A GRAND CULMINATION AND EXCITING COMPETITIONS
data.desc:
The Panabo City Sports Festival 2025 successfully concluded after three months of various sports tournaments, marked by a grand Culmination Program held at the Panabo City Gymnasium.

The event formally opened with a Holy Mass officiated by Rev. Fr. Jeremy N. Tanong, followed immediately by the official Culmination Program celebrating the achievements of athletes, coaches, and organizers who contributed to the success of the festival.

On the same day, the **Cheerdance Competition 2025** showcased energy and creativity from six participating teams across the Davao Region. The winners included:

  • Champion: Madayaw Cheer Revolution Cheetahs (₱50,000.00)
  • 1st Runner-Up: Proactive Cheer All Star (₱30,000.00)
  • 2nd Runner-Up: Cheer Cubs All Star (₱20,000.00)
  • 3rd Runner-Up: CDC Falcons (₱10,000.00)

All participating teams received a ₱5,000.00 consolation prize. Additionally, the championship games for three Basketball Tournament categories were held at the Freedom Gym, supported by City Sports Coordinator Ryan Jay Requidan.

data.title: BLESSING AND TURNOVER OF THE AIE FIRE SUBSTATION SUCCESSFULLY HELD
data.desc:
The Blessing and Official Turnover of the Anflo Industrial Estate (AIE) Fire Substation was successfully held, marking a significant milestone in the company’s strong commitment to strengthening safety and emergency preparedness. The event took place at the AIE Grounds, Barangay San Pedro, Panabo City.

The ceremony began with a ribbon-cutting, followed by the blessing of the AIE Fire Substation, symbolizing the official opening and start of operations of the facility, led by Ricardo F. Lagdameo, President of Damosa Land.

In his message, he emphasized the importance of the facility in enhancing fire safety, improving emergency response capabilities, and strengthening cooperation between the private and government sectors for the benefit of the community.

This was followed by the official turnover of the AIE Fire Substation to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Panabo, signifying the formal transfer of operational and management responsibility of the facility to the agency.

BFP Regional Director FCSUPT Junito F. Maslang also delivered a message, expressing his gratitude to ANFLO and Damosa Land for their support and efforts in providing a facility that will help ensure faster and more efficient emergency response in the city and nearby areas.

The event was attended by City Information Officer Michael Angelo A. Resueño, representing City Mayor Jose E. Relampagos; City Fire Marshal FSINSP Richard D. Quiboquibo; CLGOO-DILG Atty. Louie Limbaro; officials of ANFLO and Damosa Land; personnel of BFP Panabo; and other invited guests.

data.title: PANABO CITY SPORTS FESTIVAL 2025 WRAPS UP WITH A GRAND CULMINATION AND EXCITING COMPETITIONS
data.desc:
The Panabo City Hall Grounds came alive with color, music, and festive cheer as the city celebrated the 2025 Paskohan sa Panabo. One of the evening’s main highlights was the dazzling Fireworks Display, which illuminated the night sky and delighted both residents and visitors. The Christmas Concert added to the celebration with performances that brought warmth, joy, and holiday spirit to the community.

The program also featured inspiring and entertaining showcases from Talentadong Panaboans, along with musical performances by the High Five Music Band and the Algo Rhythm Band.

Food enthusiasts enjoyed a variety of offerings from the pop-up shops at the food park, serving an assortment of dishes and snacks perfect for the festive season.

Join us as we continue to celebrate the magic and joy of Paskohan sa Panabo!

data.title: PANABO CITY SPORTS FESTIVAL 2025 WRAPS UP WITH A GRAND CULMINATION AND EXCITING COMPETITIONS
data.desc:
The Local Government of Panabo City officially opened the 25th Araw ng Panabo, marking the start of a month-long celebration with the theme “Panaghiusa nga Nagmalampuson, Binhi sa Kaugmaon.”

The celebration began with a civic parade followed by an ecumenical mass held at the Panabo City Multi-Purpose Gym. The event served as the official opening of the various activities and programs scheduled throughout the month as part of the festivities.

In his message, City Mayor Jose E. Relampagos emphasized the importance of unity and cooperation among all sectors of the community as the foundation of the city’s continued development.

“To every Panaboanon, I extend my gratitude for your hard work, cooperation, and contributions to sustaining our city. Panabo’s success is not the work of one person alone, but the result of everyone’s efforts, with hearts ready to serve,” the Mayor said.

The 25th anniversary of Araw ng Panabo highlights the city’s continued growth, resilience, and achievements, with the active participation of leaders, organizations, and the entire community.

data.title: SASHING CEREMONY FOR BINIBINING PANABO, GINOONG PANABO, AND QUEEN OF PANABO 2026 HELD
data.desc:
The Sashing Ceremony for the candidates of Binibining Panabo, Queen of Panabo, and Ginoong Panabo 2026 was officially held at the Panabo City Hall Lobby.

During the ceremony, Executive Secretary Jo-Anne Gentiles Relampagos delivered a message on behalf of City Mayor Jose E. Relampagos, offering encouragement to the participants. Also in attendance were the reigning titleholders: Binibining Panabo 2025 Grace Marie Andres, Queen of Panabo 2025 Arvy Alumbro, and Ginoong Panabo 2022 2nd Runner-up Ireneo Caminos Jr., who showed their support for the candidates.

A total of 20 women are competing in Binibining Panabo 2026, while 12 participants are vying for Ginoong Panabo 2026, and 15 participants are competing for Queen of Panabo 2026. All candidates come from various barangays of Panabo City.

The Coronation Night is expected to be held in March 2026 as part of the celebration of the 25th Araw ng Panabo, with the theme “Panaghiusa nga Nagmalampuson, Binhi sa Kaugmaon.”

The 25th anniversary of Araw ng Panabo highlights the city’s continued growth, resilience, and achievements, with the active participation of leaders, organizations, and the entire community.
